capture_scope: One settled campaign, eleven unique admitted native executions. Captured failed/aborted response usage is included when recorded; no terminal failed job occurred. Root/controller/preparation/evaluation/support/search and unobserved provider charges are outside the measured participant subtotal.
original_row_hash_serialization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii false; source-identity hashes use literal original UTF-8 locator.

astra_api_equivalent_usd.scope: Observed jobs and captured native usage only; future work and uncaptured charges remain unknown.

cost_combination_rule: Astra API-equivalent USD and Codex credits are alternatives for the same usage. DeepSeek Go allowance is a separate valuation, not cash. Runtime catalog estimate values the same DeepSeek usage and is not added. No all-in bill or model ranking follows.

time.execution_interval_scope: Union of native-job invocation windows (including adapter setup/cleanup), not measured model inference time. Recorded elapsed/finish reconstruct terminal starts; missing active timestamps keep full union unknown. Gaps remain in wall envelope; partial gaps can overlap missing intervals.
time.wall_start_basis: Earliest recorded execution start; missing later starts bounded by job creation where available.
